title: Ganglioside lipids inhibit the aggregation of the Alzheimer's amyloid-β peptide
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,809-822
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00189C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zenon Toprakcioglu, Akhila K. Jayaram, Tuomas P. J. Knowles
The aggregation of amyloid-β (Aβ) into fibrils/plaques is associated with Alzheimer's Disease. Lipids play a crucial role in this process. We show that ganglioside lipids inhibit Aβ40/Aβ42 aggregation. This could be used to prevent fibril formation.
